title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ). The regularization term helps to prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases. This tends to shrink the coefficients towards zero, which can reduce the model's complexity and variance.
